svg.title: Google Chat: two ingest paths
svg.desc: Google Chat events arrive either synchronously on the signed webhook or asynchronously through Workspace Events subscriptions, a Cloud Pub/Sub subscription and a pull loop. Both paths run the inbound gate, then share one MessageDeduplicator before ChannelManager. WorkspaceEventsManager creates and renews the subscriptions, and slash commands and card clicks are answered inside the webhook handler.

g.text: Hover a box for its limit, failure mode or source file; its connections light up. Click it to open its section.
Inside a rendered document this image is static. Click it to open the interactive SVG.

svg.text: A signed webhook and a Pub/Sub pull both reach one MessageDeduplicator, so a message seen on both is processed once.

g.text: POSTs events with a signed JWT
Google Chat · delivers MESSAGE, ADDED_TO_SPACE, REMOVED_FROM_SPACE, CARD_CLICKED and APP_COMMAND to channels.google_chat.webhook_path
The handler answers 401 and fires a failed-auth event when the JWT does not verify.
reply goes out later via REST
GoogleChatWebhookHandler · google_chat_webhook.dart; MESSAGE gates, dedups on the resource name, sends typing and hands off
The reply goes out later through the REST client. ADDED_TO_SPACE welcomes and subscribes the space; REMOVED_FROM_SPACE unsubscribes.
answered in the handler · slash commands and CARD_CLICKED are answered in the handler and never reach ChannelManager
/new creates a task; task_accept and task_reject go to the admin-gated review handler; run actions go to the run-approval handler.
WorkspaceEventsManager · TTL 4 h with include_resource, 7 d name-only; renewal at 75% of the remaining time; user OAuth only
Startup reconcile (30 s timeout) recreates expired subscriptions, then subscribes missing spaces; a 409 ALREADY_EXISTS fetches the existing one.
subscription store · persisted under the data dir with atomic writes
Workspace Events API · delivers un-mentioned space traffic, which is the point of the subscriptions
Subscriptions are created with user OAuth; there is no service-account fallback.
Cloud Pub/Sub subscription · the subscription Workspace Events fills with message.v1.created and message.v1.batchCreated CloudEvents
Pull needs only the pubsub scope on the service account.
PubSubClient · pubsub_client.dart; 429 and 5xx back off 2^n seconds capped at 32; permanent errors wait 32 s after 10 in a row
Health: unavailable before the first pull, degraded from 5 consecutive errors; stop() waits up to 5 s; reported in /health.
CloudEventAdapter · cloud_event_adapter.dart; accepts structured CloudEvents and the Pub/Sub binding format
Filtered, LogOnly and Acknowledged are acked without further processing.
gate: mention stage off, refusal acked
GoogleChatSpaceEventsWiring · processMessage gates with the mention stage off, dedups, resolves the sender name, forwards
Display names are cached 1 h (500 entries), none rather than a raw ID on failure. A thrown error nacks and Pub/Sub redelivers.
MessageDeduplicator · bounded insertion-ordered set, capacity 1000, keyed on the Chat message resource name; first seen wins
Built only with space events enabled, Pub/Sub configured and user OAuth available; without it the webhook path skips dedup.
ChannelManager · common entry for both ingest paths; continues as in the inbound pipeline figure
The Chat session is one per space: Chat stamps threadName, which feeds thread binding but not the session key.
